issue_request: FHIR-32485 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request to clarify MedicationRequest.supportingInformation by changing the short description from supporting ordering to supporting fulfillment of the medication and changing the long description to explain fulfillment as dispensing or administering.
initial_application: Git commit 934e7819020c72ee6e3ba509ecb5445a1850f109, whose message grouped FHIR issues including 32485, changed source/medicationrequest/structuredefinition-MedicationRequest.xml from ordering wording to the requested fulfillment wording.
additional_context: MedicationRequest is active in source/fhir.ini. The current authoritative StructureDefinition and the Request-pattern mapping exception both carry the fulfillment wording. Later commit b2032629f28b8d31b9a67b46170dde873398fb0d updated the example resource name from MedicationUsage to MedicationStatement while preserving the FHIR-32485 semantics. Pharmacy May 2021 WGM minutes support the fulfillment rationale, and no Zulip or additional high-signal Confluence FTS result was found that conflicts with it.
reconciliation: No source files were changed because the current core FHIR source already satisfies the Jira resolution and remains consistent after the later MedicationStatement terminology update.
